Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.entity

Class CompanionAi

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.entity.CompanionAi
public final class CompanionAi extends Object
Doc's decisions, in priority order:
  1. attack an adjacent monster;
  2. if healthy, chase the nearest monster the player can see within HUNT_RANGE;
  3. otherwise stay within FOLLOW_DISTANCE tiles of the player.
Doc ignores sleeping monsters unless they are adjacent, so Doc will not wake a whole room.
